WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT match_api_id, season, league_id, country_id,
           home_team_api_id AS team_id, home_team_goal AS goals
    FROM main."Match"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_api_id, season, league_id, country_id,
           away_team_api_id, away_team_goal
    FROM main."Match"
),
team_seasons AS (
    SELECT season, team_id, COUNT(DISTINCT league_id) AS league_count
    FROM appearances
    GROUP BY season, team_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.match_api_id) AS match_count,
       COUNT(*) AS joined_appearances,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.season) AS season_count,
       SUM(a.season IS NULL) AS missing_seasons,
       SUM(typeof(a.goals) <> 'integer' OR a.goals < 0) AS invalid_scores,
       SUM(t.team_long_name IS NULL OR l.name IS NULL OR c.name IS NULL) AS missing_labels,
       SUM(l.country_id <> a.country_id) AS country_mismatches,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_seasons WHERE league_count > 1) AS multi_league_team_seasons
FROM appearances AS a
LEFT JOIN main.Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = a.team_id
LEFT JOIN main.League AS l ON l.id = a.league_id
LEFT JOIN main.Country AS c ON c.id = l.country_id;

WITH team_matches (season, league_id, team_api_id, goals_for, goals_against) AS (
    SELECT season, league_id, home_team_api_id, home_team_goal, away_team_goal
    FROM main."Match"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT season, league_id, away_team_api_id, away_team_goal, home_team_goal
    FROM main."Match"
),
season_totals AS (
    SELECT season, league_id, team_api_id,
           SUM(CASE
                   WHEN goals_for > goals_against THEN 3
                   WHEN goals_for = goals_against THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END) AS total_points
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY season, league_id, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT season, league_id, team_api_id, total_points,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS points_rank
    FROM season_totals
)
SELECT r.season,
       t.team_long_name AS champion_team,
       l.name AS league,
       c.name AS country,
       r.total_points
FROM ranked_teams AS r
JOIN main.Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN main.League AS l ON l.id = r.league_id
JOIN main.Country AS c ON c.id = l.country_id
WHERE r.points_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.season, t.team_long_name
LIMIT 1000
